fields.name: record_id
fields.null_meaning: Never null. A record without an identifier cannot be cited.
prohibited_interpretations: Not a scientific identifier and not stable across protocol versions.
fields.provenance_requirement: Assigned by the tooling, not by a curator.
fields.validation: Non-empty; unique within a protocol version.

fields.name: protocol_version
fields.null_meaning: Never null. A conclusion with no protocol version cannot be read under the rules it was made under.
prohibited_interpretations: Not a data version and not a source version.
fields.provenance_requirement: Copied from the protocol document in force at authoring time.
fields.validation: Must match a published protocol version.

fields.name: question
fields.null_meaning: Never null. A conclusion with no question answers nothing.
prohibited_interpretations: Not a gene/drug pair key: a pair-level conclusion must not be applied to every annotation sharing that pair.
fields.provenance_requirement: Gene and drug keys must exist in the canonical build.
fields.validation: Gene and drug canonical keys, effect dimension, question text; phenotype scope and population optional.

fields.name: question.phenotype_scope
fields.null_meaning: Empty means the conclusion is not scoped to a phenotype - not that it applies to every phenotype.
prohibited_interpretations: An empty scope is not a wildcard.
RAPID must never be read as covering ULTRARAPID (SAFETY-INV-004).
fields.provenance_requirement: Normalization must be explained in the rationale.
fields.validation: Exact Phenotype members; no aliases; RAPID and ULTRARAPID are distinct members and must both be listed to cover both.

fields.name: status
fields.null_meaning: Never null. Defaults to DRAFT, which means nobody has reviewed it.
prohibited_interpretations: DRAFT is not a rejection.
The persisted CurationStatus spells DRAFT as RAW; they are the same state under two names, not two states.
fields.provenance_requirement: Each transition records who made it and when.
fields.validation: CURATED additionally requires rationale and a distinct named reviewer.

fields.name: conclusion_state
fields.null_meaning: Never null. Absence of a conclusion is expressed as INSUFFICIENT, with a statement of what is missing.
prohibited_interpretations: Not ordered: INSUFFICIENT is not a weak SUPPORTED.
INSUFFICIENT is never low risk, no risk, no effect, safe, normal or negative evidence (SAFETY-INV-001).
CONFLICTING does not mean the disagreement was resolved.
fields.provenance_requirement: Must follow from the cited evidence via the rationale.
fields.validation: INSUFFICIENT requires an insufficiency statement; CONFLICTING requires a recorded conflict.

fields.name: conclusion_text
fields.null_meaning: Never null. A state with no sentence cannot be reviewed.
prohibited_interpretations: Not patient-facing text.
Not a recommendation, and not advice.
fields.provenance_requirement: Written by the named author.
fields.validation: Substantive text; screened for reassuring language when the state is INSUFFICIENT or CONFLICTING.

fields.name: applicability
fields.null_meaning: Never null. UNCLEAR is the honest answer when the population is not established; it is not a null.
prohibited_interpretations: APPLICABLE does not mean applicable to every population - it means applicable to the one stated.
fields.provenance_requirement: The population statement in the rationale must support it.
fields.validation: One controlled member.

fields.name: effect_dimension
fields.null_meaning: Never null. INSUFFICIENT_TO_CLASSIFY is the answer when the dimension is not established.
prohibited_interpretations: Not a treatment instruction.
Not a direction of risk: ACTIVATION says what changed, not whether that is good or bad for a patient.
fields.provenance_requirement: Normalization from the source's wording must be explained.
fields.validation: One controlled member.

fields.name: evidence
fields.null_meaning: Never empty. A conclusion with no evidence is untraceable.
prohibited_interpretations: Not a bibliography: each entry states a relationship to this conclusion.
fields.provenance_requirement: Every UUID must exist in the sealed evidence build.
fields.validation: At least one included record; no repeats; each with a written rationale.

fields.name: evidence[].relationship
fields.null_meaning: Never null.
prohibited_interpretations: CONTRADICTS is not a reason to delete the record.
CONTEXT_ONLY does not mean irrelevant.
fields.provenance_requirement: The relationship is the curator's assessment, not the source's.
fields.validation: EXCLUDED requires an exclusion_reason; every other value forbids one.

fields.name: evidence[].exclusion_reason
fields.null_meaning: Null means the record was not excluded. It never means excluded for an unstated reason.
prohibited_interpretations: Not a category that may be applied automatically: contradictory, older, other-organisation and unknown-version evidence must never be excluded by rule.
fields.provenance_requirement: Accompanied by written rationale in the same entry.
fields.validation: Required exactly when relationship is EXCLUDED.

fields.name: evidence[].trace_verified
fields.null_meaning: Null means the trace was not checked, which is different from a check that failed. Neither may be reported as verified.
prohibited_interpretations: Null is not False and False is not 'probably fine'.
fields.provenance_requirement: Derived from pgx-evidence verify.
fields.validation: Set only by a verification run against the sealed build.

fields.name: evidence[].source_version_status
fields.null_meaning: Never null. UNKNOWN_LEGACY records that a version existed and was lost; SOURCE_UNVERSIONED records that the source has none.
prohibited_interpretations: UNKNOWN_LEGACY must not be hidden behind a confidence label.
An unknown version is not an old version.
fields.provenance_requirement: Comes from the evidence build, never from the curator.
fields.validation: Copied verbatim from the evidence record.

fields.name: source_reported
fields.null_meaning: Empty means no source-reported value was recorded for comparison. It does not mean the source reported nothing.
prohibited_interpretations: significance=yes is not ConclusionState.SUPPORTED.
A ClinPGx score is not confidence, importance, strength or risk, and must not be mapped to any of them.
polarity is not a direction of patient risk.
fields.provenance_requirement: Each entry names the evidence record it came from.
fields.validation: Copied unchanged from the evidence record's own payload.

fields.name: conflict
fields.null_meaning: Never null. NONE_IDENTIFIED means nobody found a conflict, not that none exists.
prohibited_interpretations: NONE_IDENTIFIED is not a finding of agreement.
There is no precedence field, and adding one would be a change to this project's scientific position.
fields.provenance_requirement: Every conflicting record stays cited.
fields.validation: Any state other than NONE_IDENTIFIED requires at least two evidence records, a disputed field, materiality and analysis.

fields.name: conflict.material
fields.null_meaning: Null is refused on a recorded conflict: undetermined materiality is expressed as UNRESOLVED with material=False and an explanation.
prohibited_interpretations: Immaterial does not mean absent.
Materiality is not severity.
fields.provenance_requirement: Judged by a named curator.
fields.validation: Required whenever state is not NONE_IDENTIFIED.

fields.name: insufficiency
fields.null_meaning: Null means the conclusion is not INSUFFICIENT. It never means sufficiency was established.
prohibited_interpretations: Not a low-risk finding.
Not a negative result: nothing was ruled out.
fields.provenance_requirement: Must list the evidence actually reviewed.
fields.validation: Required exactly when conclusion_state is INSUFFICIENT; screened for reassuring language.

fields.name: rationale
fields.null_meaning: Null means the conclusion has not been argued, so it cannot be CURATED.
prohibited_interpretations: Not a summary of the conclusion.
A source's own wording quoted here is not an argument for the conclusion.
fields.provenance_requirement: Names the author, and the reviewer once reviewed.
fields.validation: Eleven named parts, each substantive; placeholder and circular text refused.

fields.name: rationale.authored_by
fields.null_meaning: Null means unauthored. An unauthored conclusion is not reviewable.
prohibited_interpretations: A team name, a role name or a system name is not an author.
fields.provenance_requirement: The person is accountable for the conclusion.
fields.validation: Named person, scientific role, UTC instant, written reason.

fields.name: rationale.reviewed_by
fields.null_meaning: Null means not independently reviewed, which blocks CURATED.
prohibited_interpretations: The author re-reading their own work is not an independent review.
fields.provenance_requirement: Recorded with instant and reason.
fields.validation: Must be a different person from the author, in a reviewing role.

fields.name: unresolved_references
fields.null_meaning: Empty means nothing was left dangling, not that everything resolved successfully.
prohibited_interpretations: An unresolved reference is not a resolved-to-nothing reference.
fields.provenance_requirement: Carried forward from WP-07's resolution queue.
fields.validation: Populated from the evidence build's unresolved references.

fields.name: content_hash
fields.null_meaning: Never null.
prohibited_interpretations: Not a signature and not an approval.
fields.provenance_requirement: Deterministic; two identical records hash alike.
fields.validation: sha256 over the record's content identity, excluding operational timestamps.

fields.name: is_rule_eligible
fields.null_meaning: Never null. False is the default and the safe answer.
prohibited_interpretations: Eligibility is not approval: WP-11 still requires its own review before a rule exists.
fields.provenance_requirement: Derived, never set by a curator.
fields.validation: True only for a CURATED, SUPPORTED conclusion with no blocking conflict, no insufficiency and no unresolved reference.

note: Every field states an owner and a null meaning. Null is a distinct fact, never a value, and never a reassurance.
